A map of Nigeria in 1976 showing the 19-state structure. The states are clearly outlined and labelled: Sokoto, Niger, Kaduna, Kano, Borno, Bauchi, Plateau, Gongola, Kwara, Oyo, Ondo, Ogun, Lagos, Bendel, Anambra, Imo, Rivers, Cross River, and Benue. A small distinct area in the centre is marked "FCT (Abuja)".
